question: What types of industrial safety nets are available, and what are they used for?
answer: At GCM Netting Solutions in Chennai, we offer a range of industrial safety nets, each designed for specific applications to ensure maximum protection. The primary types include: Debris Nets, used to catch falling debris and prevent materials from dropping outside construction zones, protecting pedestrians and property below. Fall Protection Nets, crucial for worker safety at heights, designed to arrest falls and minimize injury. These are commonly used in construction, scaffolding, and bridge building. Vertical Safety Nets, installed vertically to protect workers from falling from open edges or platforms. And Horizontal Safety Nets, deployed horizontally to catch falling workers or materials over a larger area. All our safety nets are made from high-density polyethylene (HDPE) material, which is UV stabilized for enhanced durability and longevity, even under harsh sunlight conditions. We provide a 3-5 year warranty on our nets, guaranteeing their quality and performance.
